what: Corrected reading 2: Narrow it: (1) do not edit athena.toml; the minimum free disk (10G) is a default in config.rs that applies when the setting is absent, so the running Athena never meets an unknown field; (2) drop criterion 4 (deleting a closed job's target/ already landed in 173d12e); (3) say 'the user' wherever the reading says 'the operator', since the boundary scan bans that word in Athena's files; (4) check free space before dispatch and before the checks, since a job's build can need about 16 GB and the disk filled on 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-25.
